evidence.claim: The useEffect hook creates a ResizeObserver and observes document.body but returns no cleanup function to call observer.disconnect() or observer.unobserve(document.body) when unmounting.
The ResizeObserver callback closes over retained payload data and runtime state, keeping allocations reachable through the document.body observation after component reversal.

recommendedFix: Return a cleanup function from useEffect that calls observer.disconnect() or observer.unobserve(document.body).
limitations: Static source analysis only; runtime memory consumption and DOM state were not measured.
